notes.title: 🌿Patch Notes 1.0612
notes.notes:
🌿Patch Notes 1.0612
🎣 Fishing Games Festival

To celebrate the Fishing Festival, we’re releasing a small update!

🌍 Added 5 new languages: Polish, Greek, Danish, Finnish, and Swedish

🗺️ Two new zones are now available: Gold Mine and Asian Biome

🛠️ Fixed a few untranslated strings

Don’t forget to share your feedback and suggestions on our DISCORD page!
👉 https://discord.gg/Fh6EPgJXMQ

notes.title: 🌸 Patch 1.0413
notes.notes:
🌸Spring Patch – Version 1.0413

Spring is here! The perfect moment to roll out the first Chill Fishing update. This is a light patch fixing a few minor issues reported by the community. Thank you for your feedback!

✅ New & Fixed: 🌍 A new language has been added: Dutch is now available!
🏆 Fixed achievements that were not validating properly.
🎣 Improved calculation of special gems.
📜 Removed unnecessary text in the fishing zone purchase panel.
💰 Rebalanced hook prices for a smoother progression.

We know Chill Fishing doesn’t revolutionize fishing games, but we are committed to listening to our community.
🎧 Don’t hesitate to share your feedback or issues via [our Discord server] or directly on Steam!
